reviews.title: I am canceling
reviews.text: The app works well. It translates exactly what’s said, but it does not have punctuation. For the language I use the app for, if there’s a pause or the voice is inflected at the end, it’s a signal that there should be punctuation. Without the punctuation, the entire meaning of what’s said is different. Because of this, I need a new app. I’m paying for this one and that seemingly minor issue is a very large problem. Even the free app I use puts punctuation. I don’t know why this one won’t. And, to make it worse, I am asked to do a review every time I use the app. I am typically using the app in the midst of a conversation. This becomes a problem when trying to communicate with others. I won’t be renewing.
